You see a moon backpack (Vol:20).
Imbuements: (Empty Slot).
It weighs 18.00 oz.

Notes

Functions like a regular Backpack but emits a weak blue light in a 3-square radius, visible only with low ambient light settings. Its value varies greatly between Game Worlds. Since the Christmas Update 2010, it has also become a rare gift from Santa Claus. Additionally, it can be obtained as a reward from the Lightbearer Event for players who light all the basins.

See Backpacks for general information regarding backpacks.
